checks.claim: 1632生于塞法迪社区、三名为义、犹太学校出众辍学佐理家业；1656绝罚最严厉且从未撤销、令文无确切罪名、推断归因三条。
checks.locator: §1 Biography：'Bento (in Hebrew, Baruch; in Latin, Benedictus: all three names mean blessed)'…'the harshest writ of herem…ever pronounced…never rescinded'；'We do not know for certain…'；否认灵魂不朽/拒超验神/律法非神授三推断

checks.claim: 莱恩斯堡磨镜、1661书信已在、《知性改进论》《短论》、几何式证明已现书信、1662'不把神同自然分开'；福尔堡1663《笛卡尔哲学原理》唯一本名著作与梅耶尔序。
checks.locator: 信1（26.viii.1661，Oldenburg：'visited you recently in your retreat at Rijnsburg'）；信2（ix.1661，几何式定义与命题并自称'prove them in the geometric manner'）；信6（iv.1662：'I don't separate God from Nature as everyone known to me has done'）；梅耶尔序与唯一本名著作见iep（'the only work that he was to publish under his own name'）；磨镜见iep（'took up lens grinding as an occupation'）

checks.claim: 1670海牙与TTP匿名出版、'地狱里伪造出来的书'、搁置《伦理学》、1675完稿不刊转作《政治论》、1677卒与《遗著》刊行、1678全荷兰被禁。
checks.locator: Life and Works：'In 1656…'；'In 1663 he moved to the town of Voorburg'；'Spinoza's last move, in 1670, was to The Hague'；'By 1675 it was complete...decided against publishing it'；'these works were banned throughout Holland'；'a firestorm of criticism'；'地狱'语见sep（'a book forged in hell by the devil himself'）；1677卒见sep（'When Spinoza died in 1677, in The Hague'）；B.D.S. Opus Posthuma见iep

checks.claim: 莱布尼茨1676年11月18—21日会于阿姆斯特丹（非海牙/非赴汉诺威途中）、谈未刊《伦理学》、笛卡尔物理学、改进的本体论证明；莱布尼茨以唯物论无神论必然论为患并作回应。
checks.locator: §1 Life：'stopped in Amsterdam to meet with Spinoza between November 18 and 21, 1676, three months before the latter's death'…'spoke of Spinoza's yet-to-be-published Ethics, Cartesian physics, and Leibniz's improved version of the ontological argument'；§2：Hobbes与Spinoza并提'materialism, atheism, and necessitarianism'…'an enormous threat'；回应框架同节——本回合已据之修正原包'赴汉诺威途中'表述
